method: Public APIs only, full saved profile fork including state/RNG/clock, same qualified selection/time policy, three played rounds
limits: One character and one checkpoint do not establish global narrative variety or personality-specific strategy.
After decisions, match results and RNG paths can diverge; no single-cause attribution of results.
Two different clocks are retained: the role commitment uses weeks, the playing-time promise uses three recorded matches.
No game engine, coefficients, sports fixture, economic rule, calendar, Godot, import, Windows or speech is changed or qualified.
